fields.Name: T332 - Create New Operation Opens Editor
fields.Description: Exercises the studio Mode='edit' flip mounting RecordProcessEditorComponent in new-draft mode (NewRecord path), distinct from opening an existing record's generic form.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher and choose 'Bulk Operations'. In the Operations section, click the 'New operation' button (plus icon, top-right of the studio bar). The view should switch to the authoring editor showing numbered sections: '1 Basics' (Name / Status / Description fields), '2 What it acts on' (Entity, Default scope, Work type dropdowns), and a toolbar with 'Save', 'Preview changes', and 'Cancel'. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the multi-section editor render is success — you do NOT need to fill it in or save.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'New operation' opens the editor with the numbered 'Basics' and 'What it acts on' sections
The editor shows the Save / Preview changes / Cancel toolbar
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
